title: Statistics for ML
motto: Statistics is how you know if your model actually works or just got lucky.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: Statistics is how you know if your model actually works or just got lucky.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: You trained two models. Model A scores 0.87 on your test set. Model B scores 0.89. You deploy Model B. Three weeks later, production metrics are worse than before. What happened?
Model B did not actually outperform Model A. The 0.02 difference was noise. Your test set was too small, or the variance too high, or both. You shipped randomness dressed up as improvement.

steps.title: The concept
steps.body: Normalize features with mean and variance. Batch norm uses running statistics; z-scores stabilize training.
